name: DAPS: Device and Produced Speech Dataset
description: The Device and Produced Speech (DAPS) dataset contains speech recorded from 20 speakers (10 male, 10 female) reading excerpts in a professional recording studio, simultaneous with recordings on consumer devices (smartphones, tablets) in realistic acoustic environments (clean, room noise, office, cafeteria).

publisher.name: Stanford University / Center for Computer Research in Music and Acoustics (CCRMA)

source_references.title: DAPS Dataset on Zenodo
source_references.notes: Zenodo archival distribution of the DAPS recordings (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.4660670).

source_references.notes: Permanent archival mirror of the DAPS recordings.

source_references.title: Can We Automatically Transform Speech Recorded on Common Consumer Devices in Real-World Environments into Professional Production Quality Speech?
source_references.notes: Published in IEEE Signal Processing Letters.

verification.notes: Verified against IEEE Signal Processing Letters publication (DOI: 10.1109/LSP.2014.2379648) and Zenodo record (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.4660670).

size.notes: 44.1kHz 16-bit uncompressed WAV recordings across clean and noisy device settings.
